| description = This outcast troll belongs to the [[Broken Skull Clan]] and can be found roaming in the [[Steamfont Mountains]]. Killing her is one of the only sources of raising [[Troll]] [[Grobb]] factions (without ruining Ogres) if you are KOS to their guards Guards and Shadowknights - [[Da Bashers]] and [[Shadowknights of Night Keep]] <br> <br> 

The spawn location, spawn time and placeholders have changed as of the October 23rd, 2024 patch (analysis done on green on 12/23/24).    Post Patch spawn location is -1,152, 1284 and the NPC or the placeholder patrols from here, through the newbie crater near druid rings, up to the LFAY path for a short walk, finally turning to the turnaround point at 1,811, 477.  Coyote is no longer the placeholder, confirmed placeholders are [[a Kobold Scout]] and [[a Kobold Shaman]].  Spawn timer is now 6:00 down from 6:40.

<br> She can be considered an undercon due to her [[Weak Poison]] ability, which procs fairly often. The DD component of this proc means that her melee attacks often hurt more than you might expect.<br> <br>
Her ally [[Lynuga]] from Innothule Swamp is the other source of this faction, but at a 2 hour respawn so Bulgglegup could be much faster source with a 6m40s respawn but at the tradeoff of 50/50 it might be the PH coyote. 
<br>

Prior to the 10/23/2024 patch information retained here in the event the prior version of Steamfont is released in a future server:  She spawned at -1442, -390 but has a PH that could be a small coyote instead. Respawn time 6m40s. Wanders near the dragon skeleton not far from Akanon and the road to the Windmills. Stops at several places, then despawns if not killed.
